delete: DELETE FROM HCP_API_EXPIRED_SYSEMPNO WHERE DAEMON_ENV = UPPER('${hcp.application.env}') AND SYS_EMP_NO IN ( SELECT IFT.ACCOUNT FROM ${hcp.apistore.ifTable} IFT )
select: SELECT HIUT.ACCOUNT FROM HCP_${hcp.apistore.ifTable} HIUT LEFT JOIN ${hcp.apistore.ifTable} IUT ON HIUT.ACCOUNT = IUT.ACCOUNT WHERE IUT.ACCOUNT IS NULL
insert:
INSERT ALL
WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM HCP_API_EXPIRED_SYSEMPNO WHERE SYS_EMP_NO = #{sysEmpNo} AND DAEMON_ENV = UPPER('${hcp.application.env}') ) THEN INTO HCP_API_EXPIRED_SYSEMPNO ( SYS_EMP_NO, BATCH_STAT_CD, DAEMON_ENV, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{sysEmpNo}, 'W', UPPER('${hcp.application.env}'), SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
select: SELECT SYS_EMP_NO, BATCH_STAT_CD FROM HCP_API_EXPIRED_SYSEMPNO WHERE DAEMON_ENV = UPPER('${hcp.application.env}') AND BATCH_STAT_CD IN ('W', 'F')
insert: INSERT INTO HCP_${hcp.apistore.ifTable} ( ACCOUNT, ACCOUNT_STATUS, COMPANY_CD, REG_DTTM ) SELECT ACCOUNT, ACCOUNT_STATUS, COMPANY_CD, SYSTIMESTAMP FROM ${hcp.apistore.ifTable}
